summary: Implements a node selector that prefers nodes below a configured per-CPU system load threshold before applying sorted selection.
responsibilities: Filter unavailable nodes before system load evaluation.
Prefer nodes below the configured per-CPU system load limit when any exist.
Delegate final node selection to shared sorted selection utilities.

summary: Node selector that filters candidates by per-CPU system load before sorting and algorithm selection.

inner.summary: Per-CPU system load threshold used to prefer low-load nodes.

summary: Filters to available nodes and narrows candidates to nodes below the system load limit when at least one low-load node exists.
summary_step: 1. Filters input nodes to currently available serving nodes.
2. Returns ErrNoAvailableNodes when no candidates remain.
3. Builds a preferred list of nodes whose normalized system load is below SysloadLimit.
4. Uses the preferred low-load list only when it is non-empty, otherwise keeps all available nodes.

summary: Filters candidate nodes by normalized system load and delegates final selection to shared sorted selection.
